corps.name: Vantablack Holdings
corps.does: Landlord-finance conglomerate. Holds the Spine's founding charter and most of the debt in orbit. Runs the Science Centre.

corps.name: Kessler Mining Co.
corps.does: Asteroid mining and salvage. Strips derelicts, buys and sells scrap, runs the Refit Bays where skiffs are fitted out.

corps.name: Ash & Iron
corps.does: Heavy industry: foundries, refineries, smelters. The smog, the slag vents and most of the jobs nobody wants.

corps.name: Null Sector Trust
corps.does: Security and insurance. Owns the patrol drones, the impound yards and, soon, detention. Insures the corps against the people.

corps.name: Cinder Collective
corps.does: Utilities cartel: air, water, oxygen, power. Everything you breathe is metered, and the Collective owns the meter.

corps.name: Gullet Provisions
corps.does: Food. Runs the Ration Depots, the protein vats and the only restaurant on the Spine (members only).

corps.name: Last Mile Freight
corps.does: Freight and logistics. Posts the courier jobs, owns the Freight Depot, and subcontracts all risk to you.

corps.name: Gavel & Rope
corps.does: Auctioneers. Runs the Auction House where dormant skiff numbers and seized property are sold. Every auction lasts 69 hours.

corps.name: Mercy Unlimited
corps.does: Medical, funerary and sponsorship. Sponsors the Spine Run, processes deaths and keeps the death count.

corps.name: Ministry of the Gentry
corps.does: Allocates Tenure Heights housing, registers the gentry, collects rent from scrappers living there, and runs affirmative action.

corps.name: The Assessor's Office
corps.does: Keeps the Land Registry and the public ledger. Enforces the 1.25× rule: any lot, any time, owner can't refuse.

corps.name: Registry of Skiffs & Souls
corps.does: Issues skiff numbers from #001, keeps the Sprawl Housing Registry, records deaths, and releases dormant numbers to auction after 13 days.

corps.name: Bureau of Public Cheer
corps.does: Morale, propaganda and the daily Corp Bulletin. Administers the Compliance Oath.
